foundation.q: What is 5/6 - 1/3? Give your answer as a fraction in simplest form.
foundation.work: Look for converting 1/3 to 2/6; common error: subtracting numerators and denominators (4/3) or leaving 3/6.

foundation.q: A ribbon 2.4 m long is cut into 6 equal pieces. How long is each piece, in metres?
foundation.work: Check place value; common error is 0.04 or 4 from misplacing the decimal point.

foundation.q: A box holds 24 pencils. How many pencils are in 35 boxes?
foundation.work: Watch the multiplication method (24 x 35 = 24 x 30 + 24 x 5); common error: dropping the carried tens.

foundation.q: A rectangle has a perimeter of 36 cm and a length of 11 cm. What is its area in square centimetres?
foundation.work: Child should find width 7 cm first (36 / 2 - 11). Common error: using 36 - 22 = 14 as the width or answering 7.

core.q: Round 4,386,512 to the nearest hundred thousand.
core.work: Look at the ten-thousands digit (8). Common errors: 4,300,000 (truncating) or 4,390,000 (wrong place).
core.skill: Place value and rounding to 10 million

core.q: Sam spent 2/5 of his money on a book. He then spent 1/3 of the remainder on lunch. He had $24 left. How much money did he have at first, in dollars?
core.work: Best seen with a bar model: remainder is 3/5, lunch is 1/5 of total, left 2/5 = $24. Common error: treating 1/3 as a fraction of the whole.

core.q: The area of a triangle is 40 square cm. Its base is 16 cm. What is its height in cm?
core.work: Child should use area = 1/2 x base x height. Common error: forgetting the 1/2 and answering 2.5, or dividing 40 by 16 only.

core.q: A tank is 50 cm long, 30 cm wide and 40 cm high. A tap fills it at 6 litres per minute. How many minutes to fill it completely? (1 litre = 1000 cubic cm)
core.work: Volume 60,000 cubic cm = 60 L. Common errors: not converting to litres, or adding the dimensions.

core.q: In a class of 40 pupils, 60% are girls. 25% of the girls wear glasses. How many girls wear glasses?
core.work: Girls = 24, then a quarter = 6. Common error: taking 25% of 40 (10).

core.q: Three angles of a quadrilateral are 90, 110 and 75 degrees. What is the fourth angle, in degrees?
core.work: Angle sum of quadrilateral is 360. Common error: using 180.

stretch.q: Look at the pattern 2, 5, 10, 17, 26, ... What is the 10th number in the pattern?
stretch.work: Look for differences 3,5,7,9 or the rule n x n + 1. Common error: guessing a constant difference.

stretch.q: Ali has 3 times as many stickers as Ben. After Ali gives 18 stickers to Ben, Ali has twice as many as Ben. How many stickers did Ali have at first?
stretch.work: Bar-model or before-after reasoning. Ben starts with 54. Common error: answering Ben's amount (54) or ignoring the change in total.

topics: Place value and rounding to 10 million
